Closed app: the EMERGENCY push plays the siren (iOS `siren.wav`, time-sensitive; Android channel `ride-emergency`, alarm usage) for phones that set `push_tokens.siren` (migration 20261105070000, `set_push_siren`); older builds keep the plain sound. Bluetooth in the background: local notification with the siren. Switch + Play Siren in Notification Settings (synced `alerts.siren.v1`, on by default)
